fact.thing: Canada Learning Bond lifetime maximum per child
fact.claim: The Canada Learning Bond puts up to $2,000 per eligible child into an RESP, and you don't have to contribute anything. It pays $500 in the first year the child is eligible, then $100 for each later eligible year up to and including age 15. From July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027, a family with 1 to 3 children qualifies if its adjusted family income is $58,523 or less. The cutoff is higher for bigger families ($66,036 for 4 children, $73,577 for 5), and the child has to be named as the beneficiary of an RESP before any money arrives.
